headlines.title: US Stock Futures Fall as Alphabet Sales Miss Revives AI Fears
headlines.summary: This is the tape-mover of the morning — Alphabet whiffed on revenue and the AI trade is cracking at the seams. When the search king stumbles AND capex comes in light alongside Microsoft, every data-center play, chip name, and cloud stock gets repriced before the open. The Mag Seven correlation breakdown just got a lot more interesting.

headlines.title: AI build-out hits snag as Google and Microsoft put off raising capex forecasts
headlines.summary: Both hyperscalers blinked on capex guidance — that's a gut-punch to every pick-and-shovel name riding the AI infrastructure wave: Nvidia, the data-center REITs, the power plays, the cooling stocks. When the two biggest spenders in the world pump the brakes, the whole supply chain feels it. This one ripples wide.

headlines.title: Eli Lilly blows past estimates, hikes sales outlook as Zepbound and Mounjaro demand surge again
headlines.summary: Lilly is raising guidance for the third time this year — that's not a beat, that's a statement. GLP-1 demand is still running hot and the bears keep getting steamrolled; this lifts the whole obesity drug complex including Novo Nordisk and puts pressure on anyone in the food, medical device, or bariatric space. One of the cleanest single-name stories on the tape today.
